name: Occidental-Vortex
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around an exposed planetary core, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.

Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on uranium, iron and exotic matter are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
